description: Records the person's own verdict on a fix after the next scan: worked true or false. Counted without names or links to learn which fixes work. Use this when the person says whether a fix worked. Do not use for a verdict the person did not give. Side effects: changes the account's own record.

gap_id.description: The gap id of the fix. Example: "5f0c2a9e-7b1d-4c3e-9a8f-2d6b4e1c7a90"

worked.description: true: the person says it worked; false: it did not. Example: true

name: rate_fix
title: Record whether a fix worked
